newsitem.title: USA: HUD secretary warns against slashing key programs.
newsitem.headline: HUD secretary warns against slashing key programs.

text.p: Housing and Urban Development Secretary Andrew Cuomo warned Congress on Tuesday not to fund renewal of expiring Section 8 contracts at the expense of community development block grants and other key HUD programs.
"Robbing Peter to pay Paul ... would be shortsighted and self-defeating," Cuomo said in testimony before the appropriations subpanel on HUD.

"While such an approach would avert the Section 8 crisis, it would simultaneously trigger other community crises in homelessness and affordable housing," said Cuomo, who called for adequate funding for the other programs as well.
Cuomo said that the "historic" budget agreement achieved 11 days ago in Washington "provides for sufficient resources to renew all expiring contracts through 2002."

But Cuomo stressed, "We cannot tolerate a budget that allows all contracts to be renewed while at the same time making severe cuts in essential HUD programs like CDBG, public housing operating support, homeless assistance, and many others."
